for attempt in range(3):
    resp = requests.get(url, params={"to": target}, timeout=5)
    if resp.status_code == 429:
        time.sleep(2 ** attempt)
        continue
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json()["rate"]
raise RuntimeError("Rate lookup failed")
